🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing and Stocks vs Bonds (Level: 8.1415 ↑ rising | SPY (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND) confirms risk preference; HYG (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +1.65%) & LQD (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND provide additional confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress rising: Credit Spread (Level: 0.7323 ↑ rising) 1W: +0.05% ABOVE TREND. Cyclicals vs Defensives (Level: 0.8131 ↑ rising) confirms cyclicals leadership.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing conditions: Yield Curve (Level: 1.0539 → flat | CORRECTION) slight flattening, Dollar (Level: 27.3200 → flat | NEUTRAL) stable, TLT (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY suggesting muted bond tailwinds.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +22.74%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/Small cap participation: Financials (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +4.63% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND. Weak: Energy XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, Utilities XLU (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -1.01%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US strong: SPY (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND. EM catch-up: EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND. Europe lagging in relative terms (Europe vs US ↓ falling | CORRECTION).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Healthy speculative bid: ARKK (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +11.61%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +3.99% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND and Speculation Index ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; small caps (IWM) also robust.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals and base metals strong: CPER (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals mixed but supportive: GLD (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND while Gold vs Stocks ratio ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy weak: XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -13.61%) in RECOVERY—watch volatility.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad leadership in Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND) and semiconductors (SOXX ABOVE TREND) with sector breadth 8/11 supportive. Divergences are minor: TLT (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY and several commodity thematic ETFs in RECOVERY/CORRECTION.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to technology and growth-leaning cyclicals (XLK, SOXX, IWM showing strength) and reduce exposure to late-cycle defensive/energy names (XLU, XLE showing weakness); bonds neutral (TLT RECOVERY) as a diversifier.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND, Semis SOXX (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +22.74%) ABOVE TREND, Financials (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, Utilities XLU (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -1.01%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND, Silver SLV (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil BNO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, watch UNG (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -13.61%) RECOVERY for mean reversion risk.

13. Key Levels?
VIX / VXX complacency metric: VIX (Level: 29.33 | 1W: +0.38% | 1M: -18.46%) RECOVERY; Stocks vs Bonds (Level: 8.1415 ↑ rising) ABOVE TREND; Credit Spread (Level: 0.7323 ↑ rising) ABOVE TREND; Tech vs Financials (Level: 2.9367 ↑ rising) ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and multiple confirmations (VXX declining and Stocks vs Bonds ↑). Technology and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX) plus small caps (IWM) showing relative strength. Key risk: rising credit stress (Credit Spread 0.7323 ↑ rising) and a minor bond/commodity divergence to monitor.
